## Summary

Describe the change and its user impact.

## Risk and trust boundaries

- [ ] No secrets, personal data, production credentials, or private URLs added
- [ ] No new untrusted HTML, URL, external script, or external endpoint added
- [ ] CSP/security-header impact considered
- [ ] Dependency changes are justified and audited

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e`
- [ ] Desktop and mobile visual check for UI changes

## Rollback

State the smallest rollback action and any migration/deployment dependency.
